info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Platform, Administration & Operations
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Platform, Administration & Operations.** Platform admin (super-admin, onboarding, SSO, federation), plugin system, audit log, usage quotas, dashboard, notifications, search and health probes.

get.summary: Get plugin manifest
get.description: Returns active plugins, licensed features, and resource limits. Called by the admin UI at startup to determine which Pro features to show.

200.description: Edition/tier, every active plugin with its UI contributions, and the effective resource limits.

get.summary: Get license info
get.description: Returns current license status (incl. organization) for the admin dashboard. Requires authentication.

200.description: License metadata. For CE (no valid license) every field is the community fallback: edition "community", null tier/organization, empty features/limits.

get.summary: Get license diagnostics
get.description: Operational license status: community (no key) vs misconfigured (no verification key) vs invalid (key rejected) vs active. Requires authentication.

200.description: Why the instance runs on the edition it reports, plus expiry/grace telemetry.

get.summary: Get plugin health
get.description: Returns active plugins (with missing Pro→Pro dependencies) and any plugins that failed to activate, with the reason and phase (compatibility/init). Requires authentication.

200.description: Active plugins, plugins that failed to activate, and plugins still using deprecated manifest event wiring.

get.summary: Get plugin frontend asset
get.description: Serves compiled frontend bundles (JS/CSS) from plugin directories. Used by the admin UI to dynamically load Pro plugin interfaces.

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: Get plugin UI translation catalog
get.description: Serves a plugin frontend i18n catalog (e.g. en.json) from the plugin's dist/frontend/i18n directory. Used by ngx-translate's HTTP loader inside Pro plugin Web Components.

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: List all organizations with stats (super-admin only)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name or slug (partial match)

200.description: Organizations across the whole platform, with owner and related record counts.

post.summary: Create a new organization with initial admin user (super-admin only)

201.description: The new organization, its initial admin user, and the auto-provisioned Content Pod when `podMode` was requested.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get organization detail with stats (super-admin only)

200.description: The organization with owner, related record counts and computed storage usage.

put.summary: Update organization settings, plan, limits (super-admin only)

200.description: The organization after the update (unchanged when the body carried no fields).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Deactivate an organization (soft disable, super-admin only)

200.description: Idempotent — `alreadyInactive: true` (and no counts) when the organization was not active.

get.summary: List users of an organization (super-admin only)

200.description: All users of the organization, oldest first. Password hashes are never returned.

post.summary: Re-issue JWT for super admin scoped to a different organization context

200.description: A fresh access + refresh token pair whose claims target the requested org.

post.summary: Set the owner of an organization (super-admin only)

201.description: The organization after the owner change (same shape as the detail endpoint).

get.summary: List all platform super-admins

200.description: All super-admins, ordered by when the role was granted (oldest first).

post.summary: Grant super-admin role to a user

201.description: The created grant, with the promoted user and their home organization.

delete.summary: Revoke super-admin role from a user

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User UUID to revoke super-admin from

200.description: The demoted user. Self-revocation and revoking the last remaining super-admin are rejected with 400.

get.summary: Get platform-wide statistics across all organizations

200.description: Cross-organization totals, plan breakdown and the newest organizations.

get.summary: List content types enabled for an organization (super-admin only)

200.description: Summary rows only (id, localized name, icon, schema version) — the JSON Schemas are not included.

post.summary: Copy a content type from one organization to another (super-admin only)

201.description: The content type row created in the target organization.

delete.summary: Disable (remove) a content type from an organization (super-admin only)

200.description: Confirmation of removal. Rejected with 409 while content items still reference the type.

post.summary: Create a new organization (onboarding flow)
post.description: Creates org with admin user, default locale, and status "onboarding". Emits onboarding.started event for plugin hooks (e.g. CD account linking).

201.description: The new organization (status "onboarding" by default), its initial admin user, and the auto-provisioned Content Pod when `podMode` was requested.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get onboarding status and quota usage for an organization
get.description: Returns organization metadata, quota limits, current usage, and onboarding progress (admin created, content types, content, locales).

200.description: Organization metadata, quotas vs. usage, the four-step onboarding checklist, and Content Pod state.

post.summary: Full data export for an organization
post.description: Creates a backup containing all content, asset metadata, content types, webhooks, and organization config as a downloadable ZIP archive.

200.description: Metadata of the created backup record (the archive itself is fetched separately via the export/backup endpoints).

post.summary: Import data from a ZIP archive into an organization
post.description: Accepts a ZIP file (multipart upload) in the standard roadbeat-studio backup format. Extracts and upserts content types, content, asset metadata, and org settings into the target organization. The original organization_id values in the archive are remapped to the target org.

200.description: Counts of the records the archive created or updated in the target organization.

post.summary: Soft-delete (archive) an organization after migration
post.description: Sets status to "archived", deactivates the organization, and revokes all API keys. Data remains in the database for potential recovery.

200.description: Idempotent — `deactivated: false` with zeroed counts when the organization was already archived.

post.summary: Create a one-time SSO token for seamless login
post.description: Called by the Web Client API (with platform admin credentials) to generate a one-time token. The user is then redirected to Studio with this token. Token is valid for 5 minutes and can only be used once.

201.description: The one-time token and its remaining lifetime in seconds.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Exchange a one-time SSO token for JWT credentials
post.description: Called by the Studio frontend after redirect from Web Client. Validates the one-time token (5-min expiry, single use) and returns a regular access token + refresh token. No authentication required.

200.description: A regular access + refresh token pair, identical to password login. The SSO token is consumed and cannot be replayed.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get federation state for an organization (or null if not provisioned).

200.description: Gateway availability plus the publisher actor. `available: false` when no Federation Gateway is configured.

post.summary: Provision (or fetch) the publisher actor for this organization.

201.description: The provisioned (or already existing) publisher actor.

put.summary: Update federation settings (toggle / display fields) for this organization.

200.description: The publisher actor after the update.

get.summary: Paginated list of remote followers for this org publisher.

200.description: Cursor-paginated followers. Filter with `status=accepted|pending|all`.

post.summary: Manually accept a pending follower (sends Accept(Follow)).
Reject a pending follower (sends Reject(Follow)).

get.summary: Paginated list of inbound replies (Discussion panel).

200.description: Cursor-paginated replies. Filter with `status=approved|pending_review|rejected|dropped|all` and `objectLinkId`.

post.summary: Approve a reply so it surfaces in the public Discussion view.

201.description: The reply with `status: "approved"` and the review audit fields set.

post.summary: Reject (hide) a reply.

get.summary: Aggregate like + announce counts for this publisher (Studio analytics only).

200.description: Publisher-wide totals, plus a per-object breakdown when `perObject=true` is requested.

get.summary: Paginated list of inbound Like + Announce activities.

200.description: Cursor-paginated reactions. Filter with `kind=like|announce|all`, `objectLinkId` and `includeUndone`.

get.summary: Moderation queue (Block + Flag activities) for this publisher.

200.description: Cursor-paginated moderation events. Filter with `kind=block|flag|all` and `status=open|resolved|dismissed|all`.

post.summary: Close a moderation event with a "resolved" outcome.

201.description: The event with `status: "resolved"` and the resolution audit fields set.

post.summary: Close a moderation event with a "dismissed" outcome.

201.description: The event with `status: "dismissed"` and the resolution audit fields set.

patch.summary: Update follow/reply moderation policy for this publisher.

200.description: The effective follow/reply policy after the update.

get.summary: CE audit log — org-scoped, read-only feed of security-relevant events

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only events at/after this ISO date

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only events at/before this ISO date

200.description: Audit events for the current organization, newest first.

get.summary: Per-org resource usage vs. effective limits (IMP-IAM-12)

200.description: Current usage and the effective limit for every quota-bearing resource (org override → license → CE default).

get.summary: List the current user's notifications (most recent first)

200.description: Notifications belonging to the authenticated user, newest first. `take` defaults to 50 and is capped at 100.

get.summary: Count the current user's unread notifications

200.description: Unread notification count for the authenticated user.

post.summary: Mark one notification as read

200.description: Idempotent — `updated: 0` when the notification was already read or does not belong to the caller.

post.summary: Mark all of the current user's notifications as read

200.description: Number of previously-unread notifications that were marked read.

get.summary: Get dashboard statistics for the current organization

200.description: Counts, storage usage and recent-activity rollups for the current organization. Cached for CACHE_TTL_DASHBOARD seconds (default 60).

get.summary: Liveness probe — process only, no dependencies

200.description: Process uptime and memory. Never touches DB/Redis/MeiliSearch, so a dependency outage cannot trigger a pod restart.

get.summary: Readiness probe — DB, Redis, search, queue depth (503 when not ready)

200.description: Per-dependency check results. Readiness requires DB + Redis ok, search not in error, and the queue not degraded; federation is reported but never gates readiness. A not-ready instance answers 503 instead.

get.summary: Health check (legacy aggregate — always 200)

200.description: Legacy shape: always 200, reporting "ok" or "degraded" plus the database/redis/search subset of the readiness checks.

get.summary: Queue health stats (admin only)

200.description: Instance-wide BullMQ job counts for the webhook and search-index queues.

get.summary: Recent slow queries (admin only)
get.description: Most-recent slow queries above SLOW_QUERY_MS. Query SHAPE only ($1/$2 placeholders) — bound values are never captured.

200.description: Recent slow-query samples, newest first, from a bounded in-memory ring buffer (lost on restart).

get.summary: Full-text search across content, assets, and users

200.description: All three result buckets are always present; the ones outside the requested `scope` carry an empty `hits` array. When MeiliSearch is unavailable every bucket is empty and `meta` reports `{ enabled: false, message }`.

post.summary: Rebuild search indexes for the current organization (admin only)

200.description: Per-index document counts. When MeiliSearch is unavailable only `message` is returned and nothing was re-indexed.

get.summary: Get search index statistics for the current organization (admin only)

200.description: Index health and per-index document counts. When MeiliSearch is disabled/unreachable only `enabled: false` is returned.
